text:
marta: Quick sync — PR #18988 is green on linux but waiting on mac matrix and we need to land before tomorrow's deploy-freeze at 03:00 UTC. Can folks take a look?

samir: on it, pinged mac infra team. if mac flakes, we should consider a short rebase window instead of a full rollback.

elaine: i can eyeball the mac logs in ~30m. what's the rebase cutoff?

marta: cutoff we discussed in planning: 02:15 UTC for any last-minute rebase/merge. after that we hold until post-freeze.

ci-bot: mac/arm64 job failed: `xcodebuild` timeout on tests/unit/ui_spec.rb (retryable). Rerun with `ci retry --job mac_arm64/unit`

josh: re-ran the mac job, it's queued. if it flakes again we should fallback to the canary variant (PR #18988-canary) and do a staged rollout.

samir: noted. if mac fails twice, i'll prepare a quick rebase: `git fetch upstream && git rebase upstream/main && gh pr push --force` — FYI that will bump CI runs.

elaine: +1 to staged rollout plan. can we add a rollforward label so releasebot knows to skip full deploy? @devops

devops: added `rollforward` label and a `hold-for-freeze` check to the release checklist. also added an alert to paging if mac matrix stays pending past 02:00 UTC.

marta: thanks. two asks: 1) if anyone lands a rebase, drop a short note here with `landed REBASE` and PR link, 2) if we're falling back to canary, call it out so product sees limited exposure.

josh: if mac clears we can merge at ~01:50 UTC to let CI settle for 25min. calling eyes on reviewers @samir @elaine :thumbsup:

samir: eyes, will approve once mac is green.

elaine: same. will approve and kick final ci checks.

ci-bot: mac/arm64 job succeeded on retry. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/18988/mac_arm64/42

marta: great — merging at 01:52 UTC then. will post `landed` after merge. thanks all :rocket:

josh: landed REBASE — https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/18988/commits/abc123. monitoring canary traces now.

devops: canary metrics look clean after 12m. no regressions in p50/p99 latency. removing `rollforward` label (still honoring hold-for-freeze).

marta: perfect. closing loop — PR merged and team synced. if anything unexpected pops up during freeze call @oncall.

samir: thanks everyone.
_meta: Generated Slack thread for merge timing coordination: last-minute rebase check, CI handoff, staged canary fallback. Unique phrasing and participant interactions follow realistic short Slack style.
